items.theme: Xi'an Silk Road city welcome culture (third-party)
items.title: The Eastern promise of Xi'an
items.quote_en: Famed for being the eastern terminus of the Silk Road... Xi'an was usually the first port of call for visitors to the East, and has a long tradition of welcoming guests from across the globe.
items.quote_cn: 西安作为丝绸之路东端，长期接待来自全球的访客，具有开放迎客传统。
items.statement_for_kb: BBC Travel describes Xi'an as the eastern terminus of the Silk Road with a long tradition of welcoming international visitors; local food (dumplings, hotpot) is part of the city experience.
items._pack_desc: 官方与国际组织：美食 / 非遗 / CGTN

items.theme: World's largest high-speed rail network (travel writer)
items.title: Visiting China? Here's how to get around in the country
items.quote_en: Indeed, this is the world's largest high-speed-rail network, connecting more than 500 cities. These ultra-modern trains reach speeds of up to 217mph (350km/h), making long distances surprisingly manageable.
items.quote_cn: Lonely Planet：中国拥有全球最大高铁网，连接逾500座城市，时速最高约350km/h。
items.statement_for_kb: According to Lonely Planet, China operates the world's largest high-speed rail network connecting more than 500 cities, with trains reaching up to about 350 km/h.

items.title: Visiting China? Here's how to get around in the country
items.quote_en: Since China is a largely cashless society, most transactions require digital payment apps like WeChat Pay or Alipay, which are essential for everything from metro fares to street food.
items.quote_cn: 中国大体已是无现金社会，地铁与街头小吃等日常支付常依赖微信/支付宝。
items.statement_for_kb: Travel guides note that everyday life in Chinese cities is largely cashless, with WeChat Pay and Alipay widely used for metro fares, street food and other daily transactions.

items.theme: Beijing hutongs as lived neighborhood culture
items.title: Discover the best neighborhoods to visit in Beijing
items.quote_en: Bookended by the magnificent sights of the 13th-century Drum Tower and the 15th-century Bell Tower, and the gorgeous 17th-century architecture of the Tibetan Buddhist Lama Temple, this is Beijing's buzziest district of historical hutong alleyways.
items.quote_cn: 鼓楼、钟楼与雍和宫一带的胡同，是体验北京日常街巷生活的代表性街区。
items.statement_for_kb: Lonely Planet describes Beijing hutong districts around Gulou and the Lama Temple as places where visitors encounter historic alleyway life on a human scale.
items._pack_desc: 日常生活 / 语言 / 体育 / 妇女 / 城市

items.title: How to get around in Beijing
items.quote_en: Beijing is a safe city, and it's tourist-friendly too. Plus you'll find plenty of signage to go with a fast, cheap and efficient transport system. Getting lost among a labyrinth of hutongs, or narrow alleyways, is a quintessential Beijing experience.
items.quote_cn: 北京交通快捷、标识较多，胡同漫步是常见城市体验。
items.statement_for_kb: Travel writers describe Beijing as relatively tourist-friendly with fast public transport and hutong walking as a classic everyday-city experience.
items._pack_desc: 日常生活 / 语言 / 体育 / 妇女 / 城市

items.theme: Expat lived experience of mobile payments
items.title: What It's Like To Live in a Cashless Society
items.quote_en: Shanghai-based Toby Graham... 'In the last four months, because of work, I have traveled to seven major cities in China and all I took with me was a passport, some clothes, and my phone... At no point did I need to take cash out.'
items.quote_cn: 在华外籍居民称可在多个中国城市仅凭手机完成支付，长时间无需现金。
items.statement_for_kb: Foreign residents interviewed by VICE report living for years in Chinese cities using primarily WeChat Pay/Alipay, sometimes traveling across major cities with only a phone and no cash.
items._pack_desc: 日常生活 / 语言 / 体育 / 妇女 / 城市

items.theme: Mobile payments embedded in urban ecosystems
items.title: Alipay and WeChat Prove That China's Future Is Cashless
items.quote_en: Only in societies where internet ecosystems have developed to the point that mobile payments can be used in urban daily life — for example, to make face to face payments, to pay utility bills, to buy tickets for travel, to book hotels, to order takeout, or to rent bicycles — can the likes of Yu'e Bao and WeChat Wallet be allowed to capture and retain large numbers of users.
items.quote_cn: Sixth Tone：移动支付已嵌入面对面付款、水电、出行、酒店、外卖与共享单车等城市日常场景。
items.statement_for_kb: Sixth Tone explains that Alipay and WeChat Pay spread because they cover everyday urban needs: face-to-face payments, utilities, tickets, hotels, takeout and bike rental.
